attempts.why: Scoping all dropdown summary selectors to the direct child summary prevents them from leaking to summaries of accordions nested inside the dropdown menu.

selfVerify.reason: Nested 'Solid (accordion)' summary is plain inside the white dropdown menu with a right-pointing accordion chevron, not a separate boxed border/background with down chevron, while the main 'Select a phase of matter' dropdown retains its correct boxed trigger styling.

pick.suspected: The nested accordion summary inside the dropdown menu is incorrectly styled as a dropdown trigger button (boxed border/background/chevron) because the dropdown summary selector leaks to descendant summaries.
